metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS precipitation dataset (daily, 0.05° resolution) - Period 1: October-November 2021 (target period) - Period 2: October-November for years 2000-2013 (long-term average) - Location: Southern Ethiopia (approximately south of 8°N latitude) 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS is precipitation data, no cloud masking needed - Just sum the precipitation values for each period 3. Logic: - Calculate total precipitation for Oct-Nov 2021 - Calculate average total precipitation for Oct-Nov across 2000-2013 - Compare: if 2021 < long-term average → A (Yes), else → B (No) - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define southern Ethiopia geometry (south of 8°N) const southernEthiopia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[33.0, 3.0], [48.0, 3.0], [48.0, 8.0], [33.0, 8.0], [33.0, 3.0]] ]); // 2. Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // 3. Get 2021 Oct-Nov data const rain2021 = chirps .filterDate('2021-10-01', '2021-12-01') .filterBounds(southernEthiopia); const count2021 = rain2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${count2021}`); if (count2021 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2021 period'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate total rainfall for 2021 const total2021 = rain2021.sum(); const stats2021 = total2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const rainfall2021 = stats2021.precipitation; if (rainfall2021 === null || rainfall2021 === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate 2021 rainfall'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 5. Get long-term average (2000-2013) let yearlyTotals = []; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2013; year++) { const rainYear = chirps .filterDate(`${year}-10-01`, `${year}-12-01`) .filterBounds(southernEthiopia); const countYear = rainYear.size().getInfo(); if (countYear === 0) { console.log(`No data for ${year}`); continue; } const totalYear = rainYear.sum(); const statsYear = totalYear.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southernEthiopia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const rainfallYear = statsYear.precipitation; if (rainfallYear !== null && rainfallYear !== undefined) { yearlyTotals.push(rainfallYear); } } if (yearlyTotals.length === 0) { console.log('No valid long-term data'); console.log('C1'); return; } const longTermAvg = yearlyTotals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / yearlyTotals.length; console.log(`2021 Oct-Nov rainfall: ${rainfall2021.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Long-term avg (2000-2013): ${longTermAvg.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Years with data: ${yearlyTotals.length}/14`); // 6. Final answer if (rainfall2021 < longTermAvg) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
